summary: 1–9, The Lord gives a commandment relative to the erection of a house for the work of the Presidency; 10–12, A printing house is to be built; 13–17, Certain inheritances are assigned.
meta_description: Revelation given through Joseph Smith the Prophet, at Kirtland, Ohio, August 2, 1833, outlining the layout of Kirtland, a stake of Zion, and appointing Hyrum Smith, Reynolds Cahoon, and Jared Carter as a Church building committee.
